name: Come find me
summary: A radar around where the poster is right now with rings for 5, 15 and 30 minutes away; friends tap their ring and hit On my way, and their face walks in along a dotted line with the minutes left.
useWhen: at kettle & crumb till 4 come say hi
im at the library till 6 if anyone wants to study
chilling at the quad, come through
just landed back, at the airport cafe for an hour
dontUseWhen: a planned event with a date and a guest list (use an RSVP)
getting home safe after a night out (use home-check)
picking a time that works for everyone (use meeting-time)

author.description: Who posted and is waiting in the middle

until.description: Until when they'll be there, short, e.g. '4pm'

friends.description: Friends who answered: ring 0 is 5 min away, 1 is 15, 2 is 30, 3 can't today; whether they're on their way, how far in (0 to 9) and their words
